housing.summary: Numbeo's 1 September 2026 contributor dataset lists a city-centre one-bedroom average of USD 4,368.58; NYC HPD limits a security deposit to one month's rent; StreetEasy's official support identifies it as part of the NYC Rental Network. Rent source: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/New-York?displayCurrency=USD Deposit source: https://www.nyc.gov/site/hpd/services-and-information/tenant-bill-of-rights.page Portal source: https://support.streeteasy.com/hc/en-us/articles/360062042051-How-does-the-NYC-Rental-Network-work

banking.summary: Bank of America says an eligible international professional opening in person needs foreign and U.S. addresses, one primary and one secondary ID, and a foreign tax identification number; a U.S. SSN is not required.
required_docs: proof of home or permanent foreign address
one accepted primary ID such as a foreign passport
one accepted secondary ID such as a foreign driver's licence or major credit card

schools.summary: New York City has international options offering the International Baccalaureate and English National Curriculum, including IGCSE and A Level pathways at the British International School of New York. NYC Public Schools' MySchools page is an official searchable school directory.

legal_admin.summary: After moving, most noncitizens in the United States must report an address change to USCIS within 10 days; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are excepted. USCIS recommends its online change-of-address tool, while Form AR-11 may be mailed.
legal_admin.registration_step: Report a U.S. address change to USCIS within 10 days through a USCIS online account or, where applicable, mailed Form AR-11.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who needs a U.S. federal tax number but is not eligible for an SSN can apply to the IRS for an ITIN using Form W-7, normally with a federal income-tax return and documents proving foreign status and identity.

transport.summary: MTA New York City Transit runs the subway and bus network. It no longer sells a 30-day unlimited MetroCard; OMNY instead caps subway and local-bus fares at USD 35 per rolling 7 days. New York DMV does not exchange licences issued outside the U.S. or Canada. Eligible newcomers can apply for Medicaid or other coverage through NY State of Health. Fare/pass source: https://www.mta.info/fares-tolls/2025-changes Driver source: https://dmv.ny.gov/driver-license/drivers-from-other-countries Healthcare source: https://info.nystateofhealth.ny.gov/enrollment
transport.network_name: MTA New York City Transit subway and bus network
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A visitor may drive on a valid foreign licence, but a New York resident seeking a state licence must apply for an original licence, pass the written test, complete the five-hour pre-licensing course, pass the road test, and surrender the foreign licence after passing.
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply through NY State of Health online, by phone at 1-855-355-5777, or with a certified Enrollment Assistor or Broker; eligibility determines whether Medicaid or another plan is available.
